rationale:
**Does not hold in general.** `find_matches` lists a registry entry from two arms: the first by the loaded plugin's `manifest.name`, the second by `PmRegistry::search`, where `PathPm::search` returns the entry's *subpath key* (directory path within the registry). The second arm skips a hit only when `m.origin == instance && m.name == info.id.name`. When the plugin's name differs from its directory subpath, the same entry is listed twice.

Reproduced with the built binary (`SYMPOSIUM_HOME` scratch dir, `cargo agents search --json`): an entry `plugins/foo-tools/Symposium.toml` with `name = "foo"` yields two `user-plugins` hits, `foo` and `foo-tools`; a bare skill at `plugins/nested/style/SKILL.md` named `style` yields `style` and `nested/style`.

The only test, `search_lists_a_registry_entry_once` (passes), covers just the case where the skill name equals its directory name (`tokio-guidance`). The reference doc (cargo-agents-search.md:28-29) only promises dedup "under the same name", narrower than this requirement. Fix options: dedup the second arm by entry (e.g. map registry plugins to their subpath ids), or narrow the requirement text.
requirement: `cargo agents search <query>` MUST list each matching registry entry at most once.
